name: Lucid Configuration and Operation Schema
description: Can be used to verify messages at: https://www.jsonschemavalidator.net/

LucidTime.description: Lucid absolute Date/Time number - a number in milliseconds from 1/1/1970 - the Unix Epoch.

configDevice.title: Device
configDevice.description: Configuration object: device (Table 1). Optional at message level; if present, entries must follow this shape.

nid.title: Node Id
nid.description: User set name of the device in its application, unique for this user's set of devices. Commonly a numeric code and used to facilitate device change.

loc.title: Location
loc.description: Location of the device, such as an address

ownr.title: Owner
ownr.description: The owner organisation of the device

asst.title: Asset
asst.description: The asset code of the device

serl.title: Serial
serl.description: The manufacturer's serial number of the device

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: WGS84 latitude. (If Location is True and this is absent then the latitude is zero).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: WGS84 longitude. (If Location is True and this is absent then the longitude is zero).

scan.title: On Scan
scan.description: True to set the device active and able to return data

conn.title: Connection String
conn.description: Optional text required by the device for this channel number. May contain device or hardware specific settings.

dns.title: DNS Information
dns.description: DNS names in a comma-separated string

num.title: Connection Number
num.description: Storage Index. The number of the connection in the FD.

prot.title: Network Protocol
prot.description: Protocol for network connection. 0 - IPv4 (TCP), 1 - IPv6 (TCP).

net.title: Network Information
net.description: IP address and port number to connect to the Broker.

configConnectionSchedule.title: Connection Schedule
configConnectionSchedule.description: Configuration object: connectionSchedule (Table 4). NOTE: this replaces the 'conn'/'mode' fields previously assumed by the Python test harness -- neither appears in the spec table; the real optional fields are start, repeat, count and startBoundary.

start.title: Start Time
start.description: The start time for the scheduled connection, as an offset in milliseconds from the start of the specified boundary.

repeat.title: Repeat Interval
repeat.description: The number of milliseconds between the start of each connection attempt.

count.title: Repeat Count
count.description: The number of repeats made after the initial connection, during the startBoundary interval.

conn.title: Device Link Connection String
conn.description: Optional device-specific string. May contain device or hardware specific settings.

configPoint.title: Point
configPoint.description: Configuration object: point (Table 8, plus calcCode/calcOnChange from Table 20). NOTE: all whenXXXX fields are action codes (Integer, 0/1/2) per the spec table, not Boolean as the Python test harness assumed. whenUnableToRead was missing entirely from the Python harness. whenOverrange was misspelled 'whenOvarrange' in the harness. calcCode is an array of numbers (compiled expression), not a single float.

parent.title: Device Link
parent.description: A reference to the Device Link for this point.

num.title: Point Number
num.description: A unique index of the point within this point type.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name is optional and is a string which can be used by the device to report data values or to display locally. The name string may contain a hierarchy of fields with a separator which can imply a structure.

className.title: Point Class
className.description: The class is optional and is a string which can be used by the SA to denote equipment or asset ontology.

scan.title: Scan Flag
scan.description: On-scan is set to True if the point is active (or needs to be made active).

scanRate.title: Scan Rate
scanRate.description: Base periodic read rate of the source data/hardware, in milliseconds. Also used if present to specify the calculation rate for Calculation points. If not specified the device may use its own rate, but is the faster of the logRate or any attached incidentLog rates.

scanOffset.title: Scan Offset
scanOffset.description: Offset time from the start of the week that the scanning is synchronised from (Monday, 00:00:00), measured in milliseconds. If 0, then log is offset from the last midnight. Also used if present to specify the calculation offset for Calculation points.

logRate.title: Log Rate
logRate.description: Base periodic logging rate (absent or 0=no logging), in milliseconds.

logOffset.title: Log Offset
logOffset.description: Offset time from the start of the week that the log is synchronised from (Monday, 00:00:00), measured in milliseconds. If 0, then log is offset from the last midnight.

whenConnected.title: When Connected
whenConnected.description: When the device has successfully contacted the Broker, the value is sent to the SA if this action is 1. (If action 2 is selected then it will not contact the SA and will behave as for action 1).

whenOnline.title: When Online
whenOnline.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenRestart.title: When Restarted
whenRestart.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenCommsLost.title: When Communications Lost
whenCommsLost.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenRemForce.title: When Remotely Forced
whenRemForce.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenLocForce.title: When Locally Forced
whenLocForce.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenChatter.title: When Chatter
whenChatter.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenOverrange.title: When Overrange
whenOverrange.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenDiscontinuity.title: When Discontinuity
whenDiscontinuity.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenRefError.title: When Reference Error
whenRefError.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenUnableToRead.title: When Unable To Read
whenUnableToRead.description: The action to be taken when this flag changes (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

whenChange.title: When Changed
whenChange.description: If the point has changed value: 0=do nothing (default), 1=log event, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA. Behaviour varies slightly with type: analogue and counter values change by a significant change deadband, strings can include any change, and digital points have their own change requirement per state.

calcCode.title: Calc Code Data
calcCode.description: Specify this only for a calculated point (the deviceLink is "Calc"). The code is compiled from an expression by the configuring application.

calcOnChange.title: Calculate On Change
calcOnChange.description: Causes calculation when any input values or their qualities change.

parent.title: Parent Point
parent.description: Binary features belong to binary parent points only.

bits.title: Bit Count
bits.description: Bit count, defaults to 1. Values are 1, 2, 3 only.

state0Action.title: State 0 Action
state0Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state0Pers.title: State 0 Persistence
state0Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state0Name.title: State 0 Name
state0Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state1Action.title: State 1 Action
state1Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state1Pers.title: State 1 Persistence
state1Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state1Name.title: State 1 Name
state1Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state2Action.title: State 2 Action
state2Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state2Pers.title: State 2 Persistence
state2Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state2Name.title: State 2 Name
state2Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state3Action.title: State 3 Action
state3Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state3Pers.title: State 3 Persistence
state3Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state3Name.title: State 3 Name
state3Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state4Action.title: State 4 Action
state4Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state4Pers.title: State 4 Persistence
state4Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state4Name.title: State 4 Name
state4Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state5Action.title: State 5 Action
state5Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state5Pers.title: State 5 Persistence
state5Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state5Name.title: State 5 Name
state5Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state6Action.title: State 6 Action
state6Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state6Pers.title: State 6 Persistence
state6Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state6Name.title: State 6 Name
state6Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

state7Action.title: State 7 Action
state7Action.description: 0=do nothing, 1=log data, 2=log data and connect to SA.

state7Pers.title: State 7 Persistence
state7Pers.description: Persistence - number of milliseconds the point must remain in this state before the action is taken. (Optional).

state7Name.title: State 7 Name
state7Name.description: Name of state, may be used locally. (Optional).

controlPulseTime.title: Control Pulse Time
controlPulseTime.description: Control Pulse time (milliseconds), applies only to 1 bit binary output points.

controlPulsePolarity.title: Control Pulse Polarity
controlPulsePolarity.description: Applies only to 1 bit binary output points. If True, then the pulse is from 1 to 0 and back to 1. If False, then the pulse is from 0 to 1 and back to 0.

parent.title: Parent Point
parent.description: Analogue features belong to analogue parent points only.

rawsc1.title: Raw Scale 1
rawsc1.description: Raw Scale 1 is the first raw value of the point (e.g. lower or zero value for the instrument).

rawsc2.title: Raw Scale 2
rawsc2.description: Raw Scale 2 is the second raw value for the scaling (e.g. higher or full scale value of the instrument).

engsc1.title: Eng Scale 1
engsc1.description: Engineering Scale 1; the first engineering value that corresponds to the first raw value (e.g. smallest scaled output that can be reported).

engsc2.title: Eng Scale 2
engsc2.description: Engineering Scale 2; the second engineering value that corresponds to the second raw value (e.g. the highest scaled value that can be recorded).

min.title: Minimum
min.description: The measurement range's minimum value, in engineering units. If a value is below the minimum, then it is under-range and the OVER_RANGE flag must be set. Under-range values should not be used when determining significant data (dead-band) changes.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: The measurement range's maximum value, in engineering units. If a value is above the maximum, then it is over-range and the OVER_RANGE flag must be set. Over-range values should not be used when determining significant data (dead-band) changes.

units.title: Units
units.description: A free format ASCII string that can be used when displaying the point value through local access displays etc. The FD should not interpret any meaning from this string and may choose to ignore it completely.

change.title: Significant Change Value
change.description: The value difference (a positive value) used to determine when the point has changed by a significant amount.

configCounter.title: Counter Point
configCounter.description: Configuration object: counter (Table 13). NOTE: the spec table has no 'parentType' field for counter, unlike its siblings binary/analogue -- only 'parent' is defined. This looks like it may be an omission in the spec itself (worth raising when proposing this upstream) since every other point-feature object pairs 'parent' with 'parentType'. The Python test harness had assumed a parentType field existed here; this draft follows the table as written.

parent.title: Parent Point
parent.description: Counter features belong to counter parent points only.

resetPeriod.title: Reset Period
resetPeriod.description: If zero or absent, then is not reset. Interval between resets of this point's value calculation, in milliseconds.

resetOffset.title: Reset Offset
resetOffset.description: Offset from start of week (Monday) in milliseconds.

reportPeriod.title: Report Period
reportPeriod.description: Interval between reports of this point's value. In milliseconds, starting at reset with last accumulated value.

scale.title: Scale Value
scale.description: Multiplies the number of counts to evaluate the value of this counter, i.e. this is the scaled value of one count.

units.title: Units
units.description: A free format ASCII string that can be used when displaying the point value through local access displays etc. The FD should not interpret any meaning from this string and may choose to ignore it completely.

change.title: Significant Change Value
change.description: The value difference (a positive value) used to determine when the point has changed by a significant amount.

configAnalogueLimit.title: Analogue Limit
configAnalogueLimit.description: Configuration object: analogueLimit (Table 14). NOTE: 'num' (Point Limit Index) is marked mandatory in the spec table but was missing entirely from the Python test harness's required-field list.

parentType.title: Parent Point Type
parentType.description: Type of point the limit refers to: "ai", "ao", "x".

name.title: Name
name.description: A human readable name for the limit.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action to be taken on entering this state (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

dirctn.title: Direction
dirctn.description: The direction for entering the state (0=positive going (low-normal-high), 1=negative going (high-normal-low)).

value.title: Limit Value
value.description: The value of this limit, in engineering units.

configCounterLimit.title: Counter Limit
configCounterLimit.description: Configuration object: counterLimit (Table 15). NOTE: like 'counter', the spec table has no 'parentType' field here. 'value' is typed Number in the spec table, not Integer as the Python test harness assumed.

name.title: Limit Name
name.description: A human readable name for the limit.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action to be taken on entering this state.

parentType.title: Parent Point Type
parentType.description: Type of point the limit refers to: "ai", "ao", "x", "c".

name.title: Name
name.description: A human readable name for the limit.

deadband.title: No Change Deadband
deadband.description: The size of the deadband within which the point value must remain to cause the no change event. Default 0.

period.title: No Change Period
period.description: The time in milliseconds that must elapse with the value remaining within the deadband to cause the no change event (0=disable no change detection).

action.title: No Change Action
action.description: Action to be taken on no change (0=do nothing, 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

configExtPoint.title: Extended Point
configExtPoint.description: Configuration object: extPoint (Table 17). NOTE: the Python test harness typed 'resetOffset' as a string (should be integer, matching the equivalent field on 'counter') and named the report-period field 'resetReport' (the spec's actual JSON name is 'reportPeriod').

parentType.title: Parent Point Type
parentType.description: Type of parent point the extension refers to: "ai", "bi", "ao", "bo", "x", "c".

num.title: Extension Point Index
num.description: Extension point number (allowable numbers defined in the min/max/totalObjects).

name.title: Name
name.description: A human readable name for the point.

className.title: Class Name
className.description: The class is optional and is a string which can be used by the SA to denote equipment or asset ontology.

type.title: Extension Point Type
type.description: Rate of Change, Min, Max, Mean, StdDev, Integral, Run Time or Count. Run times count in 1 second units, scaled by the scaleFactorType of the extension; Counters count 1 per value change to 'state' value, also scaled.

resetPeriod.title: Reset Period
resetPeriod.description: Interval between resets of this extension's value calculation, in milliseconds. If zero or absent, then is not reset.

resetOffset.title: Reset Offset
resetOffset.description: Offset from start of week (Monday) in milliseconds.

reportPeriod.title: Report Period
reportPeriod.description: Interval between reports of this extension's value. In milliseconds, starting at reset with last accumulated value.

scale.title: Scale Value
scale.description: Multiplies raw value to get value of extension.

stateMask.title: State Mask
stateMask.description: Increment the Run Time or Count when the source point state matches a state set in this bit mask. Only applies to Run Time or Count. Bit 0 is state 0, bit 1 state 1 and so on. A state mask of 0 will result in no Run Time or Count updates.

units.title: Units
units.description: A free format ASCII string that can be used when displaying the point value through local access displays etc. The FD should not interpret any meaning from this string and may choose to ignore it completely.

values.title: Values
values.description: Values array - first value applies at first time.

times.title: Times
times.description: Times array - in milliseconds from start of day.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the profile is stepped (0) or linear (1). Stepped is 'step first' and is the default.

inter.title: Interpolate
inter.description: The interpolation time (in milliseconds) used to compute a new value for the profile, interpolating between two profile points. If set to 0 then no interpolation is performed. Applies to control values.

parent.title: Parent Point
parent.description: Analogue or binary output point number.

num.title: Control Profile Index
num.description: Control Profile Index for this profile.

name.title: Limit Name
name.description: A human readable name for the limit.

configIncidentLog.title: Incident Log
configIncidentLog.description: Configuration object: incidentLog (Table 21). NOTE: 'logRate' is marked mandatory in the spec table but was listed as optional in the Python test harness.

parentType.title: Parent Type
parentType.description: Type of the source point: "ai", "bi", "ao", "bo", "c" or "x".

triggerPoint.title: Trigger Point
triggerPoint.description: Number of the point causing this log to be delivered.

triggerMask.title: Trigger Mask
triggerMask.description: Trigger occurs when point is in a state matching this bit mask. Binary inputs match by value. Analogues and counters match by alarm limit number, where the limit numbers correspond to bit numbers.

triggerStart.title: Trigger Start
triggerStart.description: The time (relative to the start of the incident) when logging is to begin, in milliseconds. Negative values mean the log starts before the trigger time.

triggerLength.title: Trigger Length
triggerLength.description: The length of time (in milliseconds) to continue logging the point after the incident.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action to be taken on entering this state (0=do nothing [not relevant in this object type], 1=log event with reason, 2=log event and trigger a connection to the SA).

logRate.title: Log Rate
logRate.description: The rate to be used (in milliseconds) to log the point.

logOffset.title: Log Offset
logOffset.description: Offset time from the start of the week that the log is synchronised from (Monday, 00:00:00). Measured in seconds. If 0, then log is offset from the last midnight. (Default 0).

messageLWT.title: LWT
messageLWT.description: Schema for a Last Will and Testament. Topic: [UUID]/UP/lwt

coreBlock.description: Used in Status message for files

messageStatus.title: StatusMessage
messageStatus.description: schema for a Status message. Topic: [UUID]/UP/status

pRef.description: Reference name of the Device Profile Version, the Manufacturer, Product name and Profile Version fields separated by underscores.

inactiveState.description: True if this device is inactive

nid.description: Node identifier used for device replacement, identifies this device to the user's application

messageCoreBlock.title: Core Block
messageCoreBlock.description: schema for a Core Block download. Topic: [UUID]/DOWN/core/block/<name>/<version-text> . Or /UP/

messageCoreBlockRequestActivate.title: Core Block Request
messageCoreBlockRequestActivate.description: schema for a Core Block Request - enable a block. Topic: [UUID]/UP/core/request

messageCoreBlockRequestDeactivate.title: Core Block Request
messageCoreBlockRequestDeactivate.description: schema for a Core Block Request - disable a block. Topic: [UUID]/UP/core/request

messageCoreBlockRequestUpload.title: Core Block Request
messageCoreBlockRequestUpload.description: schema for a Core Block Request - upload a block. Topic: [UUID]/UP/core/request

messageData.title: Data Message
messageData.description: schema for a Data message. Topic: [UUID]/UP/data

messageGetData.title: Get Data Message
messageGetData.description: Schema for a data request. Topic: [UUID]/DOWN/getdata

messageClock.title: Clock message
messageClock.description: Schema to set or get clock. Topic: [UUID]/DOWN/setclock  or: [UUID]/UP/getclock

messageGetDeviceInfo.title: Get Device Information Message
messageGetDeviceInfo.description: Schema for a Status/Device Profile/Configuration request. Topic: [UUID]/DOWN/getdata

messageRelease.title: Release override for one or more signals

messageConfiguration.title: Configuration
messageConfiguration.description: Schema for a Configuration message. Standard object arrays (device, channel, connection, etc., per Sections 2.1-2.8 of the Lucid Protocol Specification) are optional at the message level -- a device profile need not send them all -- but if present, each entry must match its object type's shape as defined in the spec's Tables 1-4, 7, 8, 11-19, 21. Object-specific fields not covered by the standard shapes (e.g. specificToDeviceProfile fields per the Device Profile) are still permitted via additionalProperties. [UUID]/DOWN/Configuration. Or /UP/. Validation requires a device array, even if empty, to distinguish from status message

messageDeviceProfile.title: DeviceProfile
messageDeviceProfile.description: Schema for a Device Profile. Topic: [UUID]/UP/profile

lucid.description: Lucid Version (only a Major version number)

pRef.description: Reference name of the Device Profile Version, the Manufacturer, Product name and Profile Version fields separated by underscores.

canCoreUp.description: Capability for file data transfers, denotes whether a block can be uploaded into the SA.

canCoreDown.description: Capability for file data transfers, denotes whether a block can be downloaded from the SA.

canConfigDown.description: Capability for the device to receive full or partial configuration messages. Note that there is no canConfigUp as this feature is mandatory for the SA to be receive configuration.

reportEventsDirectly.description: If reportEventsDirectly is specified with true, then the Field Device may send data values where the Action type is 3, and the data values associated with that event can be sent before other data values.

respondCurrentDataDirectly.description: If respondCurrentDataDirectly is specified with true, then the Field Device will respond to Supervisory Application current data request messages with the latest current data before sending older data.

items.description: Compression: (specify one or more of gzip, br[otli], deflate if compression is supported, and/or other types in future.)
A list of the security levels supported by this device.

body.description: This is the main body of the Device Profile.

deviceProfileCapability.title: Device Profile Capability Section
deviceProfileCapability.description: The Device Profile contains the device capability section. While the Object Types have fields which determine the quantities of those objects, it is common practice for devices to have ranges of object numbers. This section gives the ranges of numbers available, subject to the limits defined in the Object Types.

deviceProfileCapabilityPoints.title: Device Profile Capability Points Section
deviceProfileCapabilityPoints.description: A range is an inclusive set of integers. There can be more than one range. Multiple ranges may be used, e.g. for Physical, Virtual or External points.

deviceProfileObjectType.title: Device Profile Object Types Section
deviceProfileObjectType.description: Schema for Device Profile object types Content.

items.description: Only a list of object names.

minObjects.description: At least n need to be defined for the parent object.

maxObjects.description: No more than n can to be defined for the parent object.

totalObjects.description: No more than n can be defined for the device in total.

specificToDeviceProfile.description: Use this to specify that this object is not part of the Lucid standard Device Profile. Object to be named s_<manufacturer-name>_<field-name>.

deviceProfileObjectField.title: Device Profile Object Field Section
deviceProfileObjectField.description: Schema for Device Profile object fields Content.

specificToDeviceProfile.description: Use this to specify that this field is not part of the Lucid standard Device Profile. Field to be named s_<mnfr>_<name>.

required.description: Whether this field is required for this object, defaults to false

deviceProfileGroup.title: Device Profile Object Field Grouping Section
deviceProfileGroup.description: Schema for Device Profile object field groups Content.
